descriptions.notStarted: So If I head over to #b#p9010000##k, then I'll be able to receive an attendance sheet? I see... so this is to check my ardent attendance to MapleStory. Sounds very intriguing...
descriptions.inProgress: #b#p9010000##k told me if I take this attendance sheet to #b#p9200000##k, then I'll be able to receive PB & J Sandwich, Chocolate Milk, Chips, Cookie, and Fruit Roll Up in return. If I continue to gather the items for 14 days, then on the 15th day, I can get a special prize!  Apparently I have to come back everyday to claim the prize!
descriptions.completed: As I was successful in checking my attendance, I received scrumptious lunch items in return. I better keep these items that I received from #p9200000# somewhere safe. \n#p9200000# told me if I give him all the items on the 15th day, I'll get something nice as well!
